title: Lorwyn (novel)
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Wizards of the Coast novels)

paragraphs.text: Lorwyn is the first book in the Lorwyn Cycle . It is written by Cory J. Herndon and Scott McGough . It was published in August 2007.

Rhys is an elf , perfect in every way, born to lord over the lower races. But then a desperate ritual goes awry and he emerges disfigured, a blight upon the eyes of the beautiful. Now, hunted by his own people , he must adapt—and secure the help of those he once spurned—before it's too late.
